messages:
Noah (Marketing): Quick heads-up: were publishing the benchmark blog in ~30m. Small change: exec wants a softer wording on savings. Need legal + comms sign-off ASAP.
Ivy (Comms): Copy. Send the proposed line and Ill fold into pitches. Any embargo? Ill hold outreach until we finalize quote.
Noah (Marketing): Exec asked to change '2-4x cost savings' -> 'up to 4x observed reduction in token cost in internal tests'. Also wants an addendum that numbers vary by workload.
Ben (Product): That wording is fine technical-wise. We should put full configs into appendix and link it.
Carmen (Legal): Approve the new phrasing but remove 'internal' and use 'in our tests'. Also add: 'No customer data was used.'
Noah (Marketing): Updated line: 'Up to 4x observed reduction in token cost in our tests; results vary by workload. No customer data was used.' Ivy good to go?
Ivy (Comms): Good. Ill use that in all reporter DMs and the press kit. Holding social until I give the green.
press-monitor-bot: Monitoring enabled. Will post any pickups over 1.5k reach to #press-clips.
Noah (Marketing): Press kit URL: https://s3.internal.redwood.ai/optimize-presskit-1817123456.zip
Eli (Support): Triage channel ready: #optimize-press-triage. Added short FAQ on latency, regional availability, and how we measure cost.
deploy-bot: Publish job scheduled in 30 minutes: blog-optimize-v2
Ivy (Comms): Outreach plan: DM 6 priority contacts now; stagger EU + APAC later. Offer a 10-min technical call if they want deeper detail.
Ben (Product): If a reporter asks about hardware, offer the appendix config table and a written technical note rather than raw numbers on a call.
Carmen (Legal): One more: dont make any forward-looking claims about Dedicated SLAs. Keep it factual.
Ivy (Comms): Acknowledged.
Noah (Marketing): OK team, keep replies minimal here. Ill post a T+30 status update and escalate if we see pickup requiring response.
